command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,json,resource,hashlib
lane=Path.cwd();p=json.loads(Path('PINS.json').read_text());w=str(lane/'write_lane.py');resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_STACK,(1048576,1048576))
def sha(q):return hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for b in ['lean','leanchecker']:assert sha(Path(p[b+'_bin']))==p[b+'_sha256']
rp=lane/'replay/scalar-fragment';bd=rp/'build';bd.mkdir(parents=True);assert not list(bd.iterdir())
mods=['ParkingScalar','ParkingPositive'];records=[]
for m in mods:
 s=lane/'src'/(m+'.lean');t=rp/'src'/(m+'.lean')
 subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',w,str(t.relative_to(lane))],input=s.read_text(),text=True,check=True)
 assert sha(s)==sha(t)
env=dict(os.environ,PATH=str(Path(p['lean_bin']).parent)+os.pathsep+os.environ['PATH'],LEAN_PATH=os.pathsep.join([str(bd)]+p['upstream_lean_paths']),LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1')
for m in mods:
 s=rp/'src'/(m+'.lean');o=bd/(m+'.olean')
 for mode,a in [('compile',[p['lean_bin'],'-j1','-s8192','-M3500','-DwarningAsError=true','-o',str(o),str(s)]),('check',[p['leanchecker_bin'],m])]:
  r=subprocess.run(a,cwd=rp,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True)
  print(m,mode,r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
  records.append(dict(module=m,stage=mode,argv=a,exit=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr,source_sha256=sha(s),olean_sha256=sha(o) if o.exists() else None,LEAN_PATH=env['LEAN_PATH']))
  assert r.returncode==0
for m in mods:assert sha(rp/'src'/(m+'.lean'))==sha(lane/'src'/(m+'.lean'))
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',w,'results/scalar-fragment-replay.json'],input=json.dumps({'scope':'SCALAR FRAGMENT ONLY; full literal replay unpaid','records':records},indent=2),text=True,check=True)
